applies_to: Fronius Tauro ECO 50-100 kW commercial inverters (rest-of-world map, single MPPT), SunSpec Model Type int+SF.
summary: These inverters run the same Modbus TCP/RTU server as the Fronius GEN24 and present a SunSpec map: common block, inverter model 103, nameplate 120, settings 121, status 122, immediate controls 123, multiple-MPPT model 160 (one PV input, MPPT 1). This map covers the 16-bit measurements, ratings, state and control registers, each scaled through its SunSpec scale factor.

addressing.note: Fronius numbers SunSpec registers from 40001 and says to send the register number minus one: register 40001 is read at address 40000 (0x9C40). The manual's RTU example reads register 40005 (Mn) with address bytes 9C 44 (40004).

firmware: Register map archive 1.2.7-2 (bundled with inverter firmware 1.36.x); manual 42,0410,2649 rev. 034-28092026.

source.title: Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU (operating instructions) + Tauro_ECO_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_ROW.xlsx
source.pages: PDF English part: register addresses and examples pp. 68-70, unavailable values p. 71, scale factors pp. 74-75, Modbus settings pp. 76-79, models pp. 80-92. Register table = XLSX sheet 'Complete Map' in https://www.fronius.com/en/~/downloads/Solar%20Energy/Operating%20Instructions/gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip

notes: Register table from Fronius' official XLSX 'Tauro_ECO_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_ROW.xlsx' in gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip (archive 1.2.7-2); behaviour, addressing and settings from the Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU manual 42,0410,2649. Fronius' Modbus TCP download page lists this manual as 'Fronius GEN24, Tauro Modbus TCP & RTU Manual' (https://www.fronius.com/en-gb/uk/solar-energy/installers-partners/technical-data/all-products/system-monitoring/open-interfaces/modbus-tcp) and the ZIP as 'Fronius GEN24 & Tauro Modbus Register'.

Addresses assume SunSpec Model Type = int+SF. With float the inverter model is 113 and every later model moves by +10 registers. Fronius advises walking the model chain from 40001 rather than hard-coding addresses.

Word order: neither the manual nor the XLSX states the order of 32/64-bit values, so they are left out: SID 40001-40002, WH 40094-40095, Evt1/Evt2/EvtVnd1-2 40110-40117, ActWh 40187-40190, StActCtl 40217-40218, Tms 40223-40224, and DCWH/Tms of every MPPT input.
DCA/DCV in the inverter model (40097-40100) are left out: their scale factors are marked not supported and per-input DC values are in model 160.

Registers marked 'not supported' in the XLSX are left out (Opt, extra temperatures, VMax/VMin, ramp settings, model 160 Tmp/DCSt/DCEvt and similar), plus the storage ratings in model 120 (WHRtg, AhrRtg, MaxChaRte, MaxDisChaRte).
Many scale factors are auto-scaled (A, W, VA, VAr, DCW, Ris, model 160): read a value and its SF in the same request.
Unsupported values read as: int16 0x8000, uint16/enum16/bitfield16 0xFFFF, sunssf 0x8000.
The MPPT model (160) here reports 1 repeating input blocks: one PV input, MPPT 1; the end block is at 40284.
The Smart Meter is a separate Modbus device (default unit ID 200) with its own SunSpec map.

integration.summary: In the inverter web UI (Communication > Modbus) enable the TCP server, select int+SF and tick Allow Control if you need writes; then poll unit ID 1. Read registers 40070-40109 (wire addresses 40069-40108) for live data and model 123 for power limits.

minimum_registers.why: Inverter model ID (103) - confirms int+SF layout

integration.enable: Inverter web interface > Communication > Modbus: choose TCP Server and/or RTU Server, set SunSpec Model Type (int+SF for this map), and activate 'Allow Control' for on/off, power reduction, power factor and reactive power commands. 'Restrict Control' limits control to fixed IP addresses. Writes to the control models raise an exception when control is not allowed.
integration.watchdog: Model 123 controls have *_RvrtTms fallback timers (0-28800 s) that restart with every Modbus message; on expiry the control ends and the next-priority mode takes over. 0 (default) keeps the setting until disabled.
quirks: Off-by-one: SunSpec registers are numbered from 40001; request number minus one (40001 -> 40000).
Switching float/int+SF changes the address of every model after the inverter model.
Writes to read-only or unsupported registers are silently ignored; out-of-range values return exception 3.
setup: TCP: inverter unit ID is always 1 (identify devices by IP address); port 502 or 1502 selectable in the web UI.
RTU: set Inverter address (1-247, factory 1), interface, baud and parity in the web UI; each inverter on the bus needs a unique address.
RTU wiring: 120-ohm termination at both line ends, shielded twisted pair, strict daisy chain.
gotchas: Query sequentially (at most 2 requests in parallel) with a response timeout of at least 1 s; read blocks rather than single registers.
After changing a value of an active mode (e.g. a new WMaxLimPct), re-write the matching _Ena register with 1.
